caseName: Doe ex rel. Doe v. Todd County School District
caseNameFull: Jonathan Doe, a Minor, By and Through His Guardian and Next Friend, Dorothy Doe v. Todd County School District

opinions.text:
Motion of South Dakota Advocacy Services, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.

Same case below, 625 F.3d 459.
